card.name: Potency and purity terms in stability text
card.fires_on: Nouns about a product's quality or makeup, such as potency, purity, impurity, metabolite and detergent, in storage, stability and manufacturing passages. The pole is strongest on the end or middle of these words.

modes.label: Potency after storage
modes.description: The word potency (or its ending) in statements about loss or change of strength in stored solutions.
modes.example: may be stored at room temperature for one week without significant loss of<< potency>>.

modes.label: Impurity and purity words
modes.description: Parts of words like impurity, purity, metabolite or detergent in chemistry and manufacturing text.

card.plain: It fires on words describing a drug's strength or cleanliness, like potency and impurity, in stability and manufacturing text.
